newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 17.0 trln lire BTP, CCT.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy seen issuing 17.0 trln lire BTP, CCT.

text.p: The Italian Treasury is seen issuing 15.0 to 19.0 trillion lire of medium and long term paper at its end of the month auction, for an average of 17.0 trillion lire, a Reuter poll showed on Friday.
On April 1, 16.37 trillion lire of fixed rate BTP bonds and 11.5 trillion lire of floating rate CCT certificate mature.
"Furthermore, on April 1 some 6.6 trillion lire of CCT coupons payments and 4.6 trillion lire of BTP coupon payments come due. This month's maturities are extremely high," one analyst said.

Earlier this week, the Treasury said that it would offer a third tranche of March 1 2004 CCT, with a 3.55 percent coupon, and a ninth tranche of February 1 2007 BTPs with a 6.75 percent coupon on Thursday March 27, with settlement date of April 1.
The Treasury had already announced it would not offer the 30 year BTP at the auction.

On March 28, the Treasury has said it will offer a seventnche of February 12 2000 BTP, with a 6.0 percent coupon, and a fifth tranche of March 1 2002 BTP with a 6.25 percent coupon. Settlement for the bonds is April 2.
